title: Smart Durability & Repair
description:
Real-time tool and armor durability display on your HUD and item tooltips.
Right-click a grindstone for a 70% chance to repair 3% of item durability.
Vanilla-friendly mechanic that blocks the grindstone GUI while repairing.
body:
**This mod adds a real-time durability display for your items.**

**Key Features:**
1. Real-time Durability Display: Displays the current durability of your tools and armor both on your action bar (HUD) and directly in the item's tooltip menu when hovering over it.
 
2. Grindstone Repair: **Right-click a grindstone with a damaged item to attempt a repair. It restores 3% of the item's maximum durability per successful hit.**

3. Chance-based Mechanic: **Repairs aren't guaranteed! There is a 70% chance of success on each click. If it fails, the durability remains the same, but the grindstone will never break.**

4. Vanilla Friendly: While repairing an item, the standard grindstone interface is blocked, preventing accidental opening of the menu. Once the item is fully repaired, the vanilla GUI becomes accessible again.

 
**Language support:**
- * 🇷🇺 Русский (Россия)
- * 🇺🇸 English (US)
